about: User-agent patterns for telling podcast apps, bots, libraries and browsers apart in the media host's log. From the Open Podcast Analytics Working Group, github.com/opawg/user-agents-v2 (src/*.json), trimmed to name and pattern. Match in this order, first hit wins: bots, apps, libraries, browsers.
